{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"
","path":"/tmp/crapwork/final-verify.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs

set -e

BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"

rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"

echo "node harness exit=$?"

  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true

echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);

}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs

set -e

BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"

rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"

echo "node harness exit=$?"

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true

echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);

    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));

}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"
","path":"/tmp/crapwork/final-verify.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"
","path":"/tmp/crapwork/final-verify.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Final after-verification: instrumented node harness (green + coverage), crap4js ratchet vs
# the released baseline, target-function table, global stats.
set -e
REPO=/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
WORK=/tmp/crapwork
BIN=$WORK/tools/node_modules/.bin

rm -rf "$WORK/inst" "$WORK/cov"
cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/nyc" instrument --cwd . . "$WORK/inst"
rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$WORK/inst/"
(cd "$WORK/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

cd "$WORK/inst"
FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
node "$REPO/ci/run_with_coverage.js" \
  "$WORK/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES > "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" 2>&1
echo "node harness exit=$?"
grep -E "passed, .* failed" "$WORK/node-harness-after.log" | tail -1

cd "$REPO"
"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt" || true
echo "ratchet exit=$?"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/ratchet-after.txt"

"$BIN/crap4js" . --coverage "$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 8 > "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" || true
echo "--- target functions (final) ---"
grep -E "js/redirectToRepoAgent|js/unblockResolvedDependencies|js/fetchEpicsToInput|js/intakePreAction" "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt" | grep -v unit-tests
echo "--- global stats (final) ---"
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").split("\n");
let vals = [];
for (const l of lines) {
  const c = l.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (c.length >= 5 && /\.(js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(c[1]) && !/\/(unit-tests|test)\//.test(c[1]) && !isNaN(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]))) {
    vals.push(parseFloat(c[c.length - 1]));
  }
}
console.log("product fns measured:", vals.length, "| CRAP max:", Math.max(...vals), "| fns above 8:", vals.filter((x) => x > 8).length);
' "$WORK/crap-after-final.txt"
